name: [X10 + AURA] CITY NOT MOUNTAIN
desc:
Welcome to City Not Mountain Vol.3
Kota Bukan Gunung is an Obby Platformer game with a city atmosphere. In Vol. 3, Kota Bukan Gunung presents a Japanese city ambiance.

Features :
- Carry System (You can carry friends or other people during your exploration)
- [NEW]Daily Login (Daily Login Rewards for You)
- [NEW] Gacha System (Perform Gacha to obtain Trail and Title rewards)

Note: Like the game and join the community to get Luck Boost and other interesting information

Developed by ZiiVerse
